struct@(A,B) Pair {
  num: Int@A;
  logic: Bool@B;
}

func@(X,Y) foo() {
  let p: Pair@(X,Y) = Pair@(X,Y) { num: 1, logic: true };
  let x: Int@X = p.num;
}
---
(source-file
  (struct
    (role-type
      (role A)
      (role B)) Pair
    (struct-body
      (struct-field num
        (named-type Int@
          (role-type
            (role A))))
      (struct-field logic
        (named-type Bool@
          (role-type
            (role B))))))
  (func
    (func-sig
      (role-type
        (role X)
        (role Y)) foo
      (params))
    (scope "{"
      (let p
        (type
          (named-type Pair@
            (role-type
              (role X)
              (role Y))))
        (struct-expr Pair@
          (role-type
            (role X)
            (role Y))
          (field-init num
            (int 1))
          (field-init logic
            (bool true)) "}") ";")
      (let x
        (type
          (named-type Int@
            (role-type
              (role X))))
        (field p num) ";") "}")))
